source: AQA 7517 specification and local Paper 2 notes

topics.title: Fundamentals of data representation
points: Number systems, number bases and units of information
Unsigned binary, two's complement, fixed point and floating point representation
Character coding systems including ASCII and Unicode
Bitmap image storage, colour depth and resolution
Sound sampling, sampling rate, sample resolution and Nyquist theorem
Compression including run length encoding and dictionary based methods

topics.title: Fundamentals of computer systems
points: Hardware, software and classification of programming languages
System software and application software
Types of program translator and stages of translation
Logic gates, truth tables and Boolean algebra
Measures to protect computer systems from malware and unauthorised access

topics.title: Fundamentals of computer organisation and architecture
points: Internal hardware components of a computer
Stored program concept and the fetch-execute cycle
Processor components including ALU, control unit, registers and clock
Address, data and control buses
External hardware devices and secondary storage

topics.title: Consequences of uses of computing
points: Legal, moral, cultural and ethical issues
Privacy, surveillance, environmental impact and ownership of data
Impact of automated decision making and artificial intelligence
Stakeholders affected by computer systems

topics.title: Fundamentals of communication and networking
points: Communication methods, transmission media and protocols
Network topologies, packet switching and routing
The Internet, IP addressing, URLs, DNS and client-server architecture
TCP/IP stack, ports, sockets and standard application protocols
Network security threats and protection measures

topics.title: Fundamentals of databases
points: Relational databases, entities, attributes, relationships and keys
Entity relationship modelling
Normalisation to reduce data redundancy and update anomalies
SQL queries including SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, joins and aggregate functions
Referential integrity and transaction processing

topics.title: Big Data
points: Characteristics of Big Data: volume, velocity, variety and veracity
Distributed storage and processing
NoSQL databases and scaling large datasets
Data mining, pattern discovery and risks of using large datasets

topics.title: Fundamentals of functional programming
points: Functional programming paradigm, immutability and stateless computation
First-class functions, higher-order functions and function composition
Map, filter, reduce and recursion
Lists, heads, tails and writing functional programs
